reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets have roughly doubled since August (610→1260/month, E-06), and this is driven by bills being computed or validated incorrectly in the billing import + validation step of meter-to-cash, not primarily by missing reads: 59% of disputed bills (1785/3025) carried an ACTUAL meter read rather than an ESTIMATED one (E-03), ruling out a pure read-collection gap as the main driver. This points to either a billing validation rule change (H-RULE-CHANGE) or a cross-system read-mapping/semantic defect (H-CROSS-SYSTEM-MAPPING) emerging around August; both are currently SUPPORTED and neither is yet directly confirmed.
